primary_prediction.interpretation: LLaMA-124M has a weaker held-out diag-over-none advantage than GPT bridge

formal_design.build_rule: K, gradient, and production momentum lookahead come only from the build split
formal_design.evaluation_rule: baseline and shadow losses come only from the opposite held-out split
formal_design.step_base: checkpoint matrix-optimizer initial_lr with production shape and parameter lr multipliers
formal_design.weight_decay: checkpoint matrix-optimizer weight decay with production parameter multiplier, applied identically to every candidate

primary_gate.material_layer_rule: mean cross-architecture score exceeds max(GPT repeat SD, LLaMA repeat SD, minimum_relative_loss_margin)
primary_gate.aggregate_rule: median paired cross-architecture score exceeds minimum_relative_loss_margin

secondary_outputs_not_used_for_gate: LLaMA gate/up projection output and down-input distribution/stability

failure_policy.primary_gate_failure: stop architecture-causal escalation and do not run MECH-04
